'''Bemos''' was a [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] on the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant's]] [[Council of Moffs/Legends|Moff Council]].<ref name="Specter" /> In [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Specter of the Past]]'' to [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]].</ref> he attended a meeting with the Council and Imperial [[Supreme Commander (Galactic Empire)/Legends|Supreme Commander]] [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon]] on the<ref name="Specter" /> [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> Imperial [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bastion/Legends|Bastion]].<ref name="Specter" />

After Pellaeon suggested signing a peace treaty with the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], Moff [[Andray]] and Bemos believed the supreme commander was joking. The latter claimed that the Empire did not surrender and thought that the Empire did not have to do anything, as he believed that the conflicts in the New Republic would lead to the government's destruction. After an [[Standard hour/Legends|hour]], the meeting was over, and Bemos and the other Moffs agreed to surrender,<ref name="Specter" /> giving their credentials to Pellaeon. Eventually, the supreme commander signed a [[Pellaeon–Gavrisom Treaty|peace treaty]] with the Republic.<ref name="Vision of the Future">''[[Vision of the Future]]''</ref> During the meeting on Bastion, Moff Bemos wore a large [[codoran ring]] on his finger.<ref name="Specter" />

==Behind the scenes==
Bemos appeared in the [[1997]] novel ''[[Specter of the Past]]'', the first installment of [[Timothy Zahn]]'s ''[[Star Wars: The Hand of Thrawn Duology]]''.<ref name="Specter" />
